D5/S3/Quantum/Subentropy/POVMGram.cq_con.signature: theorem cq_conditional_subentropy_guessing (p : X → ℝ) (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) (hs : ∑ x, p x = 1) (ρ : X → DensityState B) : conditionalSubentropy p hp hs ρ ≤ 1 - pGuess p ρ ∧ 1 - pGuess p ρ ≤ -Real.log (pGuess p ρ)
